validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, extensively documented, non-GEM sources. DUPLICATE: checked against the 46-row roster -- no other row describes this same physical segment. P2502 Appalachian Gateway (Pennsylvania, 110mi) is a separate, earlier, unrelated Transco/Columbia project; no name or geography collision found. Opened 12 of the 15 harvested wiki citations (oilandgas360 via bit.ly resolve, stateimpact.npr.org, offshore-technology.com, the PGJ Oct-2018 PDF, Williams's full-service post and project-overview/timeline pages via Wayback, NextEra's 2019 acquisition PR, mercomindia.com, marcellusdrilling.com 2023, whyy.org); did not open businesswire.com (403-blocked, but its content -- Ares selling to NextEra 2019 -- is corroborated directly by NextEra's own PR which I did open) or reuters.com (not attempted, same transaction already sourced) or the blog.williams.com production-record post (lower priority, no new facts expected).
